text:
Mia - Partnerships: Hey team — kickstarting the cloud marketplace onboarding for AcmeAI (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need to align on publisher account access, trial SKU packaging, legal artifacts, and staging creds. Who can own each?
Raj - Product: I can take SKU packaging + trial flow. Quick Q: do we want a single trial SKU across clouds or cloud-specific SKUs?
Mia - Partnerships: Prefer single SKU for marketing consistency, but ok to differ if marketplace constraints force it. Raj, outline pros/cons and we'll decide.
Lucas - Legal: I'll need the End User Terms draft and a checklist of required disclosures per cloud. Can you drop the current legal bundle here (NDA, data residency note, logo usage)?
Mia - Partnerships: Dropping links: https://internal.docs/redwood/marketplace/onboard-template and the preliminary EULA draft. Also attaching the publisher enrollment checklist: AMI IDs for AWS, GCP image, Azure manifest mapping.
Olivia - Engineering: For staging creds we need an IAM role with these permissions: `MarketplaceSeller:CreateListing`, `S3:GetObject` on assets, and a publisher webhook URL. Can Sara create the role in our sandbox accounts?
Sara - Cloud Ops: I can create roles in the three staging accounts by EOD tomorrow. Need the exact permission JSON + target ARNs. Olivia, paste the minimal policy block here.
Olivia - Engineering: Minimal policy (paste):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["aws-marketplace:Subscribe","aws-marketplace:SubscribeToProduct"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-assets/*"]}
  ]
}
```
Sara - Cloud Ops: got it. Will create role names `redwood-marketplace-staging-publisher` in each account and post the ARNs.
Raj - Product: Packaging note — trial should be 14 days, seat-based meter if possible. We need to create a simple promo code mapping in the offer metadata. Also want to include a short product description (one line) and two screenshots. I'll prepare assets.
Mia - Partnerships: Important: AcmeAI legal requires logo approval step. Lucas, can you confirm timing for review?
Lucas - Legal: I'll review branding and EULA by Tuesday. If we need localized terms for EU FR/DE, that'll be an extra cycle. Flagging data residency clause for Azure EU regions.
Mia - Partnerships: Thanks. Also, pro tip for AWS listing: use `seller-verified` tag so we pass automated checks faster. Sara please enable access to AWS Seller Central staging for Acme rep `acme-pub@acme.com`.
Sara - Cloud Ops: I'll request a Seller Central invitation. Need contact + public key for account verification. Mia, can you confirm contact?
Mia - Partnerships: Contact is `jen@acme.com` and their PGP fingerprint is in the onboarding doc.
deploy-bot: New task created: `mp-onboard-acmeai-171555` assigned to partnerships. Due date: 2026-03-30.
Raj - Product: I'll draft the SKU metadata with usage examples and send to this thread by EOD.
Olivia - Engineering: One more note — model artifacts may need quantized variants for Azure GPU SKUs. Ops: please confirm allowed image size and any max manifest limits.
Sara - Cloud Ops: Noted. I'll validate image sizes against each cloud's max (AWS AMI / GCP image / Azure VHD) and report back.
Mia - Partnerships: Owners recapped: Raj = SKU & product assets; Lucas = legal artifacts & branding signoff; Olivia = integration spec + IAM policy; Sara = staging roles & seller invites. I'll track and ping next week on progress. :thumbsup:
Mia - Partnerships: Uploading an action checklist (brief):
- Create staging roles (Sara)
- Invite publisher to Seller portals (Sara)
- Draft SKU & trial metadata (Raj)
- Provide screenshots & short desc (Raj)
- Legal review of EULA & logos (Lucas)
- Engineering integration spec + webhook (Olivia)
- Confirm AMI/image manifest (Sara)
- Publish internal rollout plan (Mia)
Raj - Product: Ack. I'll post the draft SKU metadata in this thread when ready.
Lucas - Legal: Will queue branding review and ping if anything blocked.
Sara - Cloud Ops: Roles created in staging, ARNs posted: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-marketplace-staging-publisher` and equivalents for GCP/Azure. (Note: fake ARNs for demo)
Olivia - Engineering: Thanks — starting integration work. If anyone else needs access to staging logs, ping me and I'll add you.
Mia - Partnerships: Great progress. We'll reconvene Thurs 11am PT to validate everything before we request production enrollment. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
